source_ref.name: source-tree
source_ref.note: declared by the run that produced these units; nothing in this area re-hashes that tree (README gap G7)

attestation.note: which units cross the threshold for a full, published, verified attestation, and which predicate type that statement carries. Every unit gets the metadata-light record whatever this says; light_predicate is the type this closure expects the wired boundary to give that record, checked against the type the boundary publishes before any subject is sealed rather than passed to it, because the boundary takes no argument for it (README gap G15).

retention.reason: the notification body carries the reporter's own words and is kept only until delivery

delegation.reason: how deep a declared delegation chain this closure will act on. The published entry schema sets no maximum and nothing in the runner does either - the scope ladder and each hop's lifetime are computed from the chain's own length - so this is where the depth is decided; a deeper declaration is refused before any credential is issued.
